interview.name: Dane
interview.answer: It’s now scheduled for Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Uli: Let’s keep it simple: tell me the time and what needs fixing, and I’ll be there.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Dane: I’ll be there a bit late, around 3:30, and I can help with the loose fence panel.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Uli: I’m keeping an eye on where the repair drive is being held, so I can point you to the right place. If you want, I can check the exact location for you.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list and see what we still need for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be a big help. I usually end up arriving late, so I appreciate you keeping tabs on it.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Cleo: No problem — I’ll keep the list updated and let you know if anything’s running low.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll let you know when I’m heading over and remind the others too.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Dane: Thanks — I’ll swing by a bit late, around 3:30, and I can help with the loose fence panel.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive too—just tell me the time and what still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’m still confirming the exact time and the current needs, so I don’t want to guess. If you’re able, please check with the community center for the latest list and I’ll line it up once I have it.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Dane: Sure — I’ll check with the community center for the latest time and needs, then I’ll circle back.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive too—just tell me the time and what still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Eli: Good idea — I’ll make a clean list of the tools and parts first, then we can match them to each fix one by one.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Dane: Sounds good — send me the list when it’s ready, and I’ll help match the tools and parts to each fix.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can spread the word to a few neighbors and send them the details for Saturday. If you hear anything useful, let me know and I’ll keep everyone posted.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive too—just tell me the time and what still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Quinn: Great — it starts Saturday morning, and we still need help with the fence, a leaky sink, and a couple of small fixes. I’ll send you the details and spread the word to the neighbors too.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Sam: Sure thing — just come by when you’re ready and knock. I’ll be around with the hammer and screwdrivers.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam — I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive too. Just tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll jump in.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Sam: Sounds good — just send the key details when you’ve got them, and I’ll skim them fast.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Uli: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now, so that’s the place to head. If you want, I can keep an eye out for the exact time too.
events.speaker: Uli

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
